identity: Silverleaf tends its saplings for centuries; a band of confused poachers is cutting them for this week.

quests.title: Roots in the Open
quests.text: Small Boars dig up our saplings {dir_of:silverleaf:home_glades} by day; drive off eight of them. Their names are yellow, so they fight only once you strike first. Someone has also been cutting saplings at the trunk, which no boar has learned yet.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral single pulls.

quests.title: A Tool for Every Hand
quests.text: Carve a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe and show them to me. I keep yours for the seed store and give you a pair that has already learned some manners. A bow is a fine thing, but it digs poorly.
quests.lesson: Basic tools; handed-in tools are consumed, the reward replaces them.

quests.title: Fallen Wood Only
quests.text: Bring me five logs of any tree for the oven, cut outside Silverleaf's protected ground. Planks will not do; my oven likes its wood whole. The old trees will tell you they object, but any of them will serve.
quests.lesson: Any log counts, planks do not; town plants cannot be gathered.

quests.title: What Moves Under the Ferns
quests.text: After dark, Large Rats take over the same glades {dir_of:silverleaf:home_glades}. Thin out eight of them, and mind their friends: a rat in trouble calls every rat nearby. The saplings will thank you, quietly.
quests.lesson: The night clock in the same area; rats call nearby rats.

quests.title: Stone Takes Patience
quests.text: Use your wooden pick on plain stone outside town and make a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe. Bring both to me and take a tested pair back. Stone is slow to learn, but it never forgets.
quests.lesson: Tool progression; rock asks for a pick tier.

quests.title: Something Hotter Than Wood
quests.text: Bring me five Coal Lumps from the rock outside Silverleaf, whenever the hunt leaves you a free hour. Coal goes into the oven's fuel slot and raw food into the cooking slot. The oven does the rest; I only take credit for the seasoning.
quests.lesson: Gather while waiting for night; the public oven is in town.

quests.title: Patches for the Seed Baskets
quests.text: The rats chewed holes in my seed baskets, so the rats can supply the patches. Bring me two Rat Fur Patches from the Large Rats in the glades at night. Keep any spares for your own gear.
quests.lesson: Ordinary loot from an earlier hunt.

quests.title: Footfalls Without Breath
quests.text: At night, Braindead Zombies wander the {name:strand} {zone_area:strand}. Lay six of them to rest before they trample the dune grass. They burn when the sun rises, so the dark hours are the only time to find them.
quests.lesson: Zombies walk at night and burn in the sun.

quests.title: Legs for Supper
quests.text: Small Crabs walk the {name:strand} {zone_area:strand} by day. Bring me two Crab Legs for supper and keep the Crab Eyes; an enchanter wants those more than I do. The crabs are yellow, so they leave you alone until you start it.
quests.lesson: The same shore by day and by night holds different mobs.

quests.title: A Full Larder
quests.text: Bring me ten Raw Meat from your hunts; boars and rats both give it, so you may already carry some. The oven turns raw into supper. A full larder is the best answer to a poacher I know.
quests.lesson: Earlier hunt loot is useful; cooking closes the kitchen line.

quests.title: Keepers of the Saplings
quests.text: Young Foxes den in the {name:foxglades} {zone_area:foxglades} by day and eat the seed we sow. Drive off eight of them. Watch for the Aggressive Boars among them: a red name starts the fight without waiting for you.
quests.lesson: Neutral and aggressive mobs side by side.

quests.title: Two Metals Make a Third
quests.text: Smelt three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars from the ores around Silverleaf and bring them to me. They will mend the hall's hinges, and you will have my old Dual Furnace for your own work. Set it up outside protected ground.
quests.lesson: Ore to bar; a portable furnace.

quests.title: A Brush for the Flour Shelf
quests.text: Bring me two Fox Tails from the Young Foxes in the {name:foxglades}. One dusts the flour shelf, the other dusts the elder, who will not notice. After that my pantry is the best-kept in the glades.
quests.lesson: A regional drop with an ordinary use.

quests.title: Bronze for the Long Road
quests.text: Alloy fresh copper and tin into three Bronze Bars in your Dual Furnace and bring them here. The earlier bars already hold the hall together, so these must be new. Take this Bronze Pickaxe in return; the deeper rock ahead will ask for it.
quests.lesson: Alloys; the Bronze Pickaxe is the onward tool.

quests.title: Axes Without Leave
quests.text: The sapling cutters are Confused Poachers and Wood Thieves camped at the {name:poacher_camp} {dir_from_giver:poacher_camp}, day and night. Drive off seven of them, then deal with their chief, {name:misguided_poacher_chief}, who counts stumps as profit. Pull him away from his guards if you can.
quests.lesson: A camp and its normal-tier leader; pull the leader alone.

quests.title: Word for Ilyra Mossveil
quests.text: Take word of Twig's stumps to Ilyra Mossveil in Starbough Village; the road out of the glades leads up into the vale. Twig was only the youngest of the cutters, and the older ones work in Starbough. Finish what you like here first; the glades will wait, they are good at it.
quests.lesson: Start to home handoff; leave at level 10.
